data.one_liner: macOS platform implementation of the image_picker plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides macOS platform-specific implementation for picking images and videos using file selection. It works as an endorsed federated plugin for image_picker.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application for macOS that needs to pick images or videos.
You are using the main image_picker package and need macOS desktop support.
avoid_when: You need ImageSource.camera support without setting a custom cameraDelegate.
You require max width, max height, or image quality adjustments on macOS currently.
strengths: Endorsed federated plugin that integrates automatically with image_picker.
Enables file picking for images and videos on macOS.
weaknesses: Certain arguments like maxWidth, maxHeight, imageQuality, and maxDuration are not currently supported.
Requires manual addition of user-selected read-only entitlements in macOS.
data.setup_notes: Add the read-only file access entitlement (com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-only) to your macOS entitlements configuration.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main cross-platform package that automatically includes this macOS implementation.
